items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Alexander Smallens wasn't bad, neither was Rubin (inaudible). They were all nice people. I loved to do with them.

ctx.x: Can you tell me a little bit --

The only thing I can tell you about him is he's a fine fella, I didn't have no association only this theater. He was a fine fellow. Him and his brother both. Alexander Smallens wasn't bad, neither was Rubin (inaudible). They were all nice people. I loved to do with them.
